scientific_integrity: Finite numerical and rational checks are supplementary; general conclusions are established by the written proof. No independent external validation or exhaustive publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the annealed stationary Borel probability simplex at uniform zero-drift threshold. Sigma-finite measures, almost-sure pathwise behavior, rate laws and alternative distributions are not asserted. The earlier 2021 article was accessible only by abstract; an author-authored 2023 dissertation supplied the complete motivating map and strict-side comparison.
title: Critical zero-drift rigidity for stationary probabilities of a random interval map
